name: Riverside FC
description: The dominant force of modern MPL football. Two-time champions with the largest stadium in the league, Riverside Park is a fortress that few visiting sides relish visiting.
venueAddress: Riverside Park, 1 River Road, Riverside, MR2 1RP

name: Meridian City
description: The capital club and two-time champions. Playing out of the league's showpiece venue, Meridian Stadium, the Citizens combine technical quality with tactical sophistication under David Kowalski.
venueAddress: Meridian Stadium, Stadium Way, Meridian, MR1 3MS

name: Ashdown Athletic
description: The reigning champions. Ashdown's remarkable 2024-25 title run, masterminded by Sarah Mitchell, proved that ambition and coaching can overcome budget constraints.
venueAddress: Ashdown Park, Oak Lane, Ashdown, MR4 2AP

name: Northside United
description: Former champions with the best defensive record in the league. The Magpies are built on organisation, discipline, and the partnership of Torres and Akimoto at centre-back.
venueAddress: Northern Ground, Tyne Street, Northside, MR3 5NG

name: Port Heights
description: A proud coastal club with a passionate supporter base. The Dockers punch above their weight at Harbour Stadium and have a knack for producing exciting cup runs.
venueAddress: Harbour Stadium, Dock Road, Port Heights, MR6 1HS

name: Queensbury Wanderers
description: The Wanderers are never dull. Known for their attacking football and chaotic defending in equal measure, a trip to Wanderers Field guarantees entertainment.
venueAddress: Wanderers Field, Queens Road, Queensbury, MR5 4WF

name: Oakhill FC
description: A club on the rise under Rebecca Thornton. Strong set-piece routines and a promising academy have made the Oaks an increasingly tough proposition for opposition sides.
venueAddress: Oak Park, Hillside Avenue, Oakhill, MR7 2OP

name: Westbrook Rovers
description: 2020-21 champions and one of the league's founding members. The Rovers have endured a lean spell but showed glimpses of their quality with a stunning Week 12 victory over Riverside.
venueAddress: Brook Lane, Canal Street, Westbrook, MR8 3BL

name: Southshore United
description: The youngest club in the league, battling to establish themselves at the top level. Shore Park may be the smallest ground, but the atmosphere on matchday rivals anything in the MPL.
venueAddress: Shore Park, Promenade Road, Southshore, MR9 1SP

name: Stone Valley
description: The oldest club in the MPL, founded in 1886. The Quarrymen's Valley Ground is steeped in history, and their fans are among the most loyal in the division despite recent struggles.
venueAddress: Valley Ground, Quarry Lane, Stone Valley, MR10 4VG
